sections.hypothesis: One-week momentum on ETH daily (hold the next week after a rising week, else cash) beats ETH held at the same average exposure on Sharpe, and does so out of sample, not only over 2020-25 as a whole.
sections.rationale: The earlier notes (one-week-momentum-btc-eth-daily, weekly-momentum-on-btc-followers-eth-unseen) were rejected under their own rules: it failed on BTC, on ETH's unseen 2017-19 (Sharpe 0.13 vs 0.15) and on SOL. Under the 2026-11-14 scorecard the ETH 2020-25 run passes the edge test (1.23 vs 1.12), so its decision was moved to watch. This note completes the scorecard once, on ETH only. Written after the ETH 2020-25 and 2017-19 results were seen, but before any window-by-window result. The rule has no settings, so nothing can be tuned.
sections.rules: Implementation weekly-momentum, ETHUSDT 1d, 2020-01 to 2025-10, 330 USDT, costs from kestrel.toml. (1) kestrel backtest ETHUSDT --strategy weekly-momentum --research <this note> --interval 1d --start 2020-01 --end 2025-10 --cash 330. (2) kestrel walk-forward ETHUSDT --strategy weekly-momentum --research <this note> --interval 1d --start 2020-01 --end 2025-10 --train-months 24 --test-months 6, with no grid: the fixed rule judged in each of 7 six-month windows.
sections.falsification: Graded on the scorecard. The luck test is expected to fail (deflated Sharpe about 29% at 172 trials), so the note cannot pass outright. It survives, and the ETH decision stays watch, only if every other applicable test passes: edge, walk-forward (beats holding in at least 4 of 7 windows), start dates (at least 50% of 2-year windows), costs (break-even at least 2x actual), at least 30 trades, drawdown no deeper than 50%. Robustness doesn't apply (no settings). Any other failure rejects the note and moves ETH to drop. Run once.
sections.parameters: None. The week is fixed at 7 calendar days, decided at Sunday's close.
sections.costs: About 23 bps a round trip on ETH; break-even was about 277 bps in the 2020-25 run. This run and the walk-forward's single look each count as a trial.

history.reason: Passed every applicable test but luck (deflated 29%), then failed the holdout; weekly momentum dropped 2026-11-14. Cleanup (Luke, 2026-11-15).
